'''Chris Liotta''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 Williston Park tournament]] on 20 February 2000 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|CCT]], according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d272">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-williston-park-new-york-2-20-00d272/ williston-park-new-york-2-20-00], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 20 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-20-williston-park-new-york-2-20-00d272/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
